nodes.description: Nonisogenic patient fibroblasts and age/sex/passage-matched controls were compared for elastin deposition, splicing and signaling. Reduced insoluble elastin and abnormal deposition accompanied allele-dependent intracellular effects. CL 1 lacked the measured stress response; CL 4 mainly increased BiP; CL 3 showed BiP, phospho-eIF2alpha and cleaved-caspase3 changes. Increased pSMAD2 was observed across all three tested patient cultures.
